reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 19.1 gives professional/workmanlike performance and material conformance to documentation; § 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformance warranty (measured from the later of delivery or acceptance) and term-length conformance for Hosted Services; § 19.3 covers Applicable Law compliance and no intentionally introduced malicious code.

Remedy in § 19.4 is real and adequate (prompt re-performance/repair/replacement, escalating to termination of the affected item plus refund of Fees paid) and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.

Disclaimer in § 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty — no carve-out edit needed.

The failed deterministic period check is a false negative: 'ninety days' is spelled in words rather than digits, a phrasing variant the regex cannot match; the substantive period meets or exceeds the preferred benchmark.

Correctly no redline and no counterparty comment for a compliant finding; the only shortfall noted ('Fees paid' rather than 'paid or payable') is an immaterial sub-element the playbook directs be noted rather than flagged.
